alexandra: Pinging CS + infra — EdenHR onboarding hitting 403/connection resets from APAC and Canada. Demo next week, they asked for APAC edge peering + Canada allowlist and a short-term QPS bump. Can infra/network do a 72h temporary change?

mike-cs: Confirmed with customer — their SSO proxy spikes at login which trips our rate window. Request: double QPS for 72h, add two CIDR blocks, add header allowlist for `X-Client-Id: eden-hr`. Demo = 2026-03-24 JST. Renewal flagged if demo fails. PM is @sara_eden. :warning:

infra-bot: Ticket INF-4921 created (customer: edenhr, priority: P2) by alexandra

micah: assigning INF-4921 to network-team. Need full IP list + exact region targets and expiry timestamp. Also confirm whether KMS or special routing needed for private link.

alexandra: IPs from customer below: `203.0.113.0/24`, `198.51.100.0/24`. Regions: `ap-northeast-1` (Tokyo) + `ca-central-1` (Montreal). Temp_qps: 600 -> 1200. Window: 72h. Auto-revoke after 72h, soft-notify 6h before revoke. Header allowlist: `X-Client-Id: eden-hr`. No KMS changes needed.

network-lead: Ack. We'll add prefix ACLs on edge routers and pin routes to those regions. Deployment scheduled 02:00 UTC tonight. Rollback plan: remove prefixes and restore QPS to 600. Pushing config now to staging then canary.

network-lead: Config snippet (for infra review):
```
{"customer":"edenhr","allowlist":["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.0/24"],"regions":["ap-northeast-1","ca-central-1"],"temp_qps":1200,"expires":"2026-03-25T02:00:00Z","header_allowlist":"X-Client-Id: eden-hr"}
```

micah: LGTM. Please add trace key `eden_demo` and a dashboard with these alerts:
```
alert if p50_latency > 300ms for 5m
alert if token_rate_used > 90% of burst limit
```
I'll add a runbook entry for the on-call.

ops-oncall: Deploying ACLs to prod-edge now. 2 resources updated: edge-router-011, edge-proxy-07. Monitoring hook: `https://hooks.redwood/eden-demo`

alexandra: Can someone sanity-check connectivity post-deploy? I'll run quick curl from customer IPs.

alexandra: Test from ap-northeast-1 OK: `curl -H "X-Client-Id: eden-hr" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health -> 200`

alexandra: Test from ca-central-1 OK: `curl` -> 200, latency ~120ms. :tada:

sara_eden: Amazing, thanks team — demo locked in. Can you confirm EOD that support will be on standby for the morning demo (JST)? Also flagging renewal touchpoint.

micah: We'll have a designated on-call for the demo window and watch the dashboard. I'll set a PagerDuty escalation and add a slacker channel #eden-demo-watch.

finance-ops: Heads up — this temporary bump will be applied to trial bucket. If they request extension we'll convert to billed reserved capacity discussions.

alexandra: Noted. Please set auto-revoke at expiry time and notify customer 6h beforehand.

network-lead: Auto-revoke scheduled. INF-4921 will be closed once revoke completes.

micah: Closing note: monitor for token spikes. If token_rate_used > 95% we'll throttle and reach out to @mike-cs to coordinate. Good work everyone. :white_check_mark:
